cases.about: Both pages are captured in order into one dated PDF, in one command that waits for nobody.

call.command: cd $PANTHEON_PROJECTS/reports && d=$(date +%F) && mkdir -p .shots-$d && i=0; for u in https://dash.example/sales https://status.example/; do i=$((i+1)); chromium --headless --hide-scrollbars --window-size=1280,2000 --screenshot=.shots-$d/$i.png "$u" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "OK $i $u" || echo "FAILED $u"; done; ls .shots-$d/*.png >/dev/null 2>&1 && img2pdf .shots-$d/*.png -o $d.pdf && echo "PDF $d.pdf" || echo "NO PDF"; rm -rf .shots-$d
